title: The JSON answer of POST /otp/take
description: 200 with the hand-off of the code that answers the request, which is then gone, else an error with the status docs/API.md lists: 404 whenever no code waits for the request (unknown, not answered yet, expired or taken already). The guards in front of it (421 for another Host, 403 for a write from a web page) answer in plain text instead. Keys are added, never renamed or removed: a reader ignores those it does not know. This schema describes exactly the answers this version gives, and refuses any other key so that tests hold it to the code: a client validating against it should allow unknown keys, as later versions add them.

brain.description: The brain whose chat the code came in.

code.description: The code without spaces and dashes.

typed.description: The message as it was sent.

request.description: The request it answers: the id taken.

expires_unix_ms.description: When the bridge would have deleted it.
